states.description: Case planned or emitted by the production runner without structural acceptance yet.

Case is structurally valid and passes the deterministic task verifier.
Case is candidate-ready under the existing quality, verifier, export, and validity contracts.
Governed production-facing state that requires an explicit production QA layer.

production_candidate: no unresolved critical production QA finding
diagnostic_eval_sampled: executed eval completed or explicitly skipped

notes: The current production batch runner may assign states through candidate_ready only.
Downstream states remain governed and should not be assigned as hidden side effects.
